Standardized Execution

What Every Site Survey Delivers

Consistent field measurements and photographic documentation tailored directly to your engineering team's exact requirements.

Attic & Structural Framing

Rafter size, spacing, span, roof pitch, framing health, and decking thickness accurately recorded with clear measurement rulers.

Main Service Panel & Electrical

Bus rating, main breaker ampacity, utility meter number, grounding electrode, available breaker slots, and conduit pathways.

Battery & ESS Clearance

NFPA 855 setback verification, wall backing condition, pathway to MSP, and indoor/outdoor environmental clearances.

Shading & Aerial Photogrammetry

Drone roof surface capture, obstruction coordinates (vents, skylights, plumbing stacks), and high-resolution solar irradiance context.
